question: If a face-down creature loses its abilities, can it still be turned face up with a disguise ability?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it no longer has a disguise ability or a disguise cost once face up, so it cannot be turned face up that way.
expected.answer: If a face-down creature loses its abilities, it can't be turned face up with a disguise ability because it will no longer have a disguise ability (or a disguise cost) once face up.
